name: GLOAM: VESPER
tagline: Deliver the last letters without being read.
description: A hand-etched stealth puzzle platformer about private money on public chains. As Vesper, the courier, slip through towns where every wall remembers, keep your letters sealed from readers and front-runners, and deliver what was promised. Narrated story, field notes, keepsakes and a Seal Book of proofs to master.
controls: Arrows to move, Up or Space to jump, Down to hide in shadow, E to interact, Tab: Seal Book, H: hint, Esc: pause. Gamepad and touch work.
